name: Unable or unwilling to explain transaction purpose or origin
description: When asked about a transaction, the customer gives vague, rehearsed, inconsistent or shifting explanations of its purpose, source or counterparties.
fp: Unsophisticated customers may explain poorly; compare explanation with documents and profile.

links.name: Customer unable to explain transaction purpose or origin
links.ctx: Explanations for layered transfers are vague, inconsistent or shift when challenged.

links.name: Evasive or scripted answers about payment purpose
links.ctx: Victim-side: when asked about the payment, the customer gives rehearsed, inconsistent or irritated answers, or says they were told to mislead the bank.

links.name: Customer or courier evasive about cash origin
links.ctx: Gives inconsistent accounts or refuses declarations.

links.name: Customer lacks understanding of the transactions it executes
links.ctx: Controllers cannot explain commercial purpose or counterparties.
